scientific_integrity: The source's necessary reduction is checked against its full text. The new algebraic step is the exact identity \((b+2)(3t-2-a)=3(2t-1)\), whose divisor parametrization is reversible. The converse membership in \(S\) is verified symbolically from the prime exponents of \(\varphi(3^aP_t^b)\). Finite computation is used only as a regression test.
scientific_limitations: The classification is exact only for the odd two-prime branch with both exponents at least two, together with the source's isolated exponent system. It does not decide whether \(2\cdot3^t+1\) is prime for infinitely many \(t\), and it does not classify other prime-support branches.
title: Divisor parametrization of the odd two-prime branch of \(\tau(n^2)=\tau(\varphi(n))\)
